label: ICL7662 (DIP)
description:
ICL7662 Charge Pump DC-to-DC Voltage Converter in DIP8 package


The ICL7762 can be viewed as an upgrade to the TC7660. It is a charge pump that can be used to double a voltage, invert a voltage, or divide a voltage by two. Because it doesn't need an inductor, use of a charge pump can be simpler than using a boost converter. If you need a a higher voltage than your input at low current, the ICL7660 can be a good choice.


The ICL7662 was originally developed by Intersil and has become and industrial standard part that is produced by many manufacturers, such as Maxim, Microchip (TC7662), On Semi (NCP7662).
